source_extracts.label: USPS FAQ — Return Receipt basics
source_extracts.quote: Return Receipt must be purchased at the time of mailing; shows recipient's signature, delivery date; electronic receipt delivered via email

source_extracts.label: USPS FAQ — Certified Mail basics
source_extracts.quote: Certified Mail provides proof of mailing and delivery record; PS Form 3800 receipt; moves at the speed of the underlying mail class, not guaranteed
